rows.item: [HRIS] Gift Tracker Recently filled / updated — who used the link, and an alert to HR
[HRIS] Sending a second copy of a pay document asks first, and the copy is labelled Reissued or Amended rather than counted as an attempt
[HRIS] The HSL Branches KPI calculator can score the upcoming week
[HRIS] The Accounting → People Pay button shows only for the CEO — the button, not the pay route
[HRIS] Anniversary Gifts pick their gift from Gift items, items show a reference price again, and the free-form Suggestions card is gone
[HRIS] Gift Tracker Orders — approved gifts are locked into a priced PDF invoice, and the tab badge counts the gifts still open
[HRIS] A Gift Tracker order invoice can be deleted, and locking one shows a Creating invoice overlay
[HRIS] The Gift Tracker Submissions tab pages at 20
[HRIS] CEO Penny runs on Opus 5.5 with every Admin tool, and can map who holds access over whom
[HRIS] A leaver with no master row gets termination documents from the pay ledger, never by writing a master row back, and the starting rate is optional
[HRIS] The Payment Dispatch hero leads with the pay week — one Start/Stop control, no heading or source filename, and a finished processor shows a green check
[HRIS] A failed pay read on Payment Dispatch shows an error instead of claiming no Hubstaff cycle was uploaded
[HRIS] A rehire’s promote reactivates their own off-boarded master row instead of leaving them invisible, and refuses a row on a different personal email
[HRIS] The Payment Catalog re-reads the roster on refetch, so a transfer moves the sub-team headcounts
[HRIS] A Personal Email cell holding a name instead of an address no longer wins paystub delivery, and five of the six paystubs it blocked are sent
[HRIS] Employees can no longer pick their sending bank — only Accounting sets it, and the approval queue is retired
[HRIS] The Employee Profile puts the ID card beside the information, matches the Overview navy in dark mode, and drops the Selected channel line
[HRIS] A manager may transfer someone out of a department they also manage, and never releases their own request
[HRIS] Closing a Support ticket notifies the employee
[HRIS] The bank-update OTP page and its code email warn that Simple never asks for a card number, CVV or expiry
[HRIS] The Missing Bank Info email carries the same card-safety warning — the live n8n workflow takes the new Build Recipients code
[HRIS] The People Bank changes feed filters by bank type
[HRIS] The Current Banks Who banks here list has unique row keys
[HRIS] The Start Processing peer modal names who started it, and the cue is no longer cut at 12 seconds
[HRIS] People Search Bar — find a person by name or work email and read their bank details inline, as the first People tab
[HRIS] The Search Bar person record gets Profile, Payroll and PAB tabs, and Payroll counts the bonuses
[HRIS] Integrations → Data catalog — every dataset outside systems may read, may one day read, or never will
[HRIS] HR Onboarding loads every submission and staged hire past 1,000, and splits Archived from Archived/Complete
[HRIS] HR Onboarding All shows live submissions only, Archived gets its own pill, and the hero card and Lead Gen Bulk promote button are gone
[HRIS] Three more readers capped at 1,000 rows now page — the work-email taken set, the New Hire Checklist and the rates sync
[HRIS] The AI/API Team’s own managers read SP Rankings on My Team, and the Employee tab stays Kane’s
[HRIS] My Team Appointments ranking for Lead Gen and Callback — most appointments set, with tenure
[HRIS] My Team Rankings leaderboard for appointment teams — average appointments per day, week and month
[HRIS] PM Team Rankings rank by bonus earned, shown as KPI items
[HRIS] KPI Rankings for every per-person KPI-bonus department, cached per department, with Client VA order-only
[HRIS] Rankings gets a top-3 podium, a board-shaped skeleton and search by name or work email
[HRIS] Rankings View — one person’s KPI and ranking performance, week by week
[HRIS] HR, QC and Accounting get KPI Rankings and View as team boards
[HRIS] HSL sub-teams get KPI Rankings and View, ranked on the KPI Calculator’s stored bonus
[HRIS] The Overview Payroll Notes card tracks wizard Steps 1–8, open steps first, in place of New hires and Attrition
[HRIS] The Hi Kane payroll cycle greeting lists the unfinished wizard steps and jumps to Step N
[HRIS] The blueprint skill takes its own recommendations and builds, stopping only for a closed NEEDS list
[HRIS] The Issues table moves smoothly, and a time-adjustment proof opens in a viewer with Next and a preview strip
[HRIS] The Payroll Wizard’s all-uploads PAB merge is one streamed server call, byte-identical to the old result
[HRIS] The Employee Overview PAB calendar follows a wizard PAB Period save live
[HRIS] Every Payroll Wizard write leaves an audit row with the right actor, the Hubstaff uploader included
[HRIS] KPI Calculator Add External Member finds people in the manager’s other departments
[HRIS] Lead Gen can save and lock its KPI week again — the replace-set delete no longer puts every kept id in the URL
[HRIS] Orientation on My Team pages its weeks, and each week’s people, at 10
[HRIS] The offboarding queue dialogs render light in light mode
[HRIS] Seven more HSL KPI branches are scored from the Payment Catalog — their hardcoded rules retired, and the Mgr column dropped
[HRIS] KPI Calculator insight cards — department spotlight, top earner and the Sent-to-Accounting trend
[HRIS] Carla gets a Jellyfish Jam play bubble every five active minutes
[HRIS] Send to OMS — the Orphanage step returns each person’s regular and OT hours and paid amount to OMS
[HRIS] The Employee KPI Bonus figures refetch when the kpi.scored toast arrives, not after a reload
[HRIS] The Orphanage paste adds up a person’s repeated lines and prices the total once
[HRIS] The Start Processing cue plays one minute, then fades out
[HRIS] KPI figures are live on every dashboard — a server Broadcast from all six KPI write routes
[HRIS] Payment Dispatch holds every pending payee under US$15.00 at Threshold on load, and says how many
[HRIS] The Pending and Excluded queues swap their violet avatar gradient for lime → green
[HRIS] The HSL Branches KPI Calculator gets the insight cards, and both calculators’ loading skeletons reserve the card row
[HRIS] The Supabase Advisor’s four security errors are closed — RLS on three anon-writable tables, and active_employees runs as the caller
[HRIS] A received gift can no longer be flipped back, nobody records or clears their own gift, and Clear needs a written reason
[HRIS] The Manager Bonus History tab is retired
[HRIS] The Sep 29 docs sweep — 31 sessions documented, Termination Letters and Update Bank Info get feature docs, and the reference and UI standards catch up
